m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Isn't there anywhere an old Treant can go to rest on his roots? Who dares disturb the serenity of Snowbeard... you will suffer for it!
Enough! You've proven your mettle, soft-skin. Why do you trouble an old Treant so? Baba Yaga? You wish to visit the witch?
Hmm. If you will meet me back out in the Boughs, I will show you why that is a problem.
Baba Yaga lives behind here, in the Veiled Vale. The Boughs block your path. Long ago, I could've parted them for you, but it is now forbidden.\n
Ivan. It's been a while. What brings you out here? You have a delivery for the witch?
In matter of speaking, yes. My comrade here is Wizard from Ravenwood, and needs your help to find Baba Yaga's House.
Then this wizard is either very brave or very foolish. Baba Yaga does not allow visitors. Nor is her house easy to find.
Are you aware of the risk you are taking, Wizard? Very well, then. I will help you, but don't say I didn't warn you.
Thank you, Zoya. And now, Ivan the Great must hurry to Urville Station. Goodbye for now, comrade, and good luck!
The rumors say Urville Station has fallen on hard times. Ivan may be facing as much danger as you, my friend.
Baba Yaga's house is hidden deep in the Thick Boughs. Many souls have wandered into these woods and never returned.
The Snow Treants do not allow trespassers. I suspect that is why the witch chose their forest for her home.
To find Baba Yaga, you must have the Snow Treants' cooperation. You'll have to confront their leader, Snowbeard, in the Cold Clearing.
I wish I knew another way, but I do not. You'll have to convince Snowbeard to show you how to get to Baba Yaga's house.
